items.title: danielscholl/agent-base
items.design: Detailed ADR/spec corpus and clear seams for provider, skills, memory and middleware.
items.limitations: Do not copy/vendor source; do not infer current API compatibility; do not run credentialed or costly paths without authorization. Uses public Context/ContextProvider and client surfaces from an early beta; target revision changed multiple Python names, so route is architectural and tests are not proof of current API.

items.title: AgentEvalHQ/AgentEval
items.design: Deep reusable evaluation abstractions, adapters, reports, datasets and benchmark composition.
items.limitations: Do not copy/vendor source; do not infer current API compatibility; do not run credentialed or costly paths without authorization. Pins the same 1.13 generation as target revision and documents breaking-change checks; preview Foundry/Harness remain sample-only.

items.title: luisquintanilla/dotnet-ai-conference-assistant
items.design: Coherent end-to-end application with ingestion, retrieval, specialized agents, workflow and MCP boundaries.
items.limitations: Do not copy/vendor source; do not infer current API compatibility; do not run credentialed or costly paths without authorization. rc4 public .NET surface predates target 1.13; retain architecture, verify all constructor/hosting symbols.

items.title: AIDotNet/OpenDeepWiki
items.design: Large real application showing repository ingestion, retrieval and multi-provider boundaries.
items.limitations: Do not copy/vendor source; do not infer current API compatibility; do not run credentialed or costly paths without authorization. Stable core 1.7 patterns are near-current but target is 1.13; Anthropic/AzureAI previews require separate checks.

items.title: comet-ml/opik
items.design: Production observability platform and a low-coupling OTLP export pattern.
items.limitations: Do not copy/vendor source; do not infer current API compatibility; do not run credentialed or costly paths without authorization. MAF route relies on standard OpenTelemetry rather than a pinned MAF adapter; docs currently show Agent/OpenAIChatClient and .NET ChatClientAgent, which must be checked at target revision.

items.title: cristofima/TaskAgent-AgenticAI
items.design: Strong clean-architecture separation, persistent chat store and explicit streaming/event mapping.
items.limitations: Do not copy/vendor source; do not infer current API compatibility; do not run credentialed or costly paths without authorization. Architecture is reusable; the Nov-2025 preview AG-UI and agent APIs are stale against target 1.13 and must not be copied literally.

items.title: getzep/zep
items.design: Focused adapter with explicit identity/state ownership, graceful-degradation semantics and parameter exposure controls.
items.limitations: Do not copy/vendor source; do not infer current API compatibility; do not run credentialed or costly paths without authorization. Targets >=1.8.1 and explicitly audits framework session/state limitations; verify target 1.13 provider hooks before reuse.

items.title: Azure-Samples/interview-coach-agent-framework
items.route: service boundaries, handoff application, MCP/AG-UI/hosting composition.
items.design: clear host/agent/MCP/UI/service-default decomposition and a concrete handoff-driven application.
items.limitations: assuming sample auth, evaluation, resilience or rollout is complete. exact cloud behavior and dependency resolution were not locally run.

items.title: Azure-Samples/azure-ai-travel-agents
items.route: MAF Python service/MCP/workflow/degradation-test architecture at pinned commit.
items.design: enterprise-style separation of UI, API implementation, MCP servers, containers and infrastructure; useful comparison without conflating framework-specific packages.
items.limitations: treating other-framework packages as MAF patterns or using the open dependency range unpinned. exact clean build and cloud deployment were not reproduced.

items.title: microsoft/agent-framework
items.route: exact-revision implementation, design, samples and tests through catalog routes.
items.design: source, tests, decisions and samples permit a four-way evidence bundle for exact symbols.
items.limitations: assuming all features are GA or samples are production defaults. live main and published packages can diverge from this source snapshot.

items.title: microsoft/agent-governance-toolkit
items.route: route MAF middleware/governance/security design to the immutable .NET integration and its tests, then verify target package compatibility and deployment policy semantics.
items.design: a thin adapter maps MAF run/tool surfaces into a framework-neutral policy kernel; deny decisions fail closed before inner execution; audit events are emitted; extension methods avoid application-specific middleware duplication.
items.limitations: do not copy external code; do not claim the toolkit alone provides compliance; do not use example identity/policy/audit defaults without threat modeling and tests. broad governance claims can be over-applied without verifying enforcement coverage and fail-closed behavior in the target host.

items.title: microsoft/spec-to-agents
items.route: route workflow/HITL/tool/CI/deployment questions to the immutable commit, then map APIs against target `5ab8877...` and local tests.
items.design: specs describe the intended workflow; implementation uses typed executors and bidirectional coordinator edges; HITL is an explicit protocol; external capabilities are separated into tools; tests cover both workflow behavior and tool contracts.
items.limitations: do not copy external code; do not silently upgrade beta syntax; do not treat mocked tests as live-provider proof. deployment completeness may obscure missing tenant, eval, retry, and rollback decisions.
